summary: Drafted three hub page bodies containing 24 internal links with a malformed host (drivetodevelop.com, missing the n; correct is driventodevelop.com) and 2 em-dashes, despite having just helped build a pipeline gate enforcing exactly these rules. The creating subagent flagged it; initial denial ('that doesn't match what I wrote') was wrong. First fix attempt was a no-op (identical strings on both sides of the replace, unverified). Second attempt fixed all 24 occurrences and verified zero remaining.
proposed_fix: Before presenting any deliverable for approval: run a programmatic check (grep) for banned patterns (em-dashes) and verify link hosts against the live domain, rather than trusting self-perception of what was written. After any bulk string replace, verify the change landed by grepping for the old pattern. Source drafts now clean; created Ghost draft pages being updated with corrected bodies.
